extractions.notes: No extractable destination itineraries found. Drew Binsky's public products are general travel-skills, not destination plans: his book 'Just Go: A Globe-Trotting Guide to Travel Like an Expert, Connect Like a Local, and Live the Adventure of a Lifetime' (2024) covers visas, befriending locals and language barriers across 197 countries, and his drewbinsky.com travel course covers general travel hacks/secrets. His YouTube/Instagram content is destination vlog footage (e.g. '$10 in Yemen, Syria, Iran') with no structured day-by-day plans, hotel/activity/restaurant recommendations tied to a reusable trip. A targeted Instagram author-search for his itinerary posts returned zero results. Per honesty rules, no itinerary was forced.

items.details: About six homestays on Derawan Island, all huts on stilts over the water

itineraries.summary: Emmett Sparling's guide to the Derawan Islands off Borneo, published in HOLR Magazine: where to stay (overwater homestays), where to eat (warungs), and what to do (Jellyfish Lake on Kakaban Island, snorkelling and free diving, biking Derawan). A recommendation list tied to his photography trip rather than a day-by-day plan, so no day count is stated.
itineraries.title: Visit Borneo: Derawan Islands guide by Emmett Sparling

extractions.notes: One itinerary extracted. Sparling's own site (emmettsparling.com) is a photography portfolio/travel journal with no structured itineraries. The HOLR Magazine guide is published in his words ('Visit Borneo: Guide by Photographer Emmett Sparling') with where-to-stay/eat/do structure tied to his trip.

items.details: Arrive via Bristol (BRS), Birmingham (BHX) or London Heathrow (LHR); rental car essential for villages
items.name: Arrive + rental car

items.details: Author's recommended home base: Chipping Campden. Boutique options Noel Arms and Cotswold House Hotel on the high street, or Airbnbs (Hook Cottage, Hicks House, Butcher's Flat, Iconic 17th Century Thatched Cottage)
items.name: Chipping Campden base stay

items.details: Easy evening stroll down Chipping Campden high street, dinner in town
items.name: High street stroll + dinner

items.details: Arrive ~9am before tour buses; coffee at The Den (local feel); low stone footbridges over the River Windrush
items.name: Bourton-on-the-Water morning

items.details: Quieter afternoon wandering Upper Slaughter and Lower Slaughter, connected by country lanes
items.name: Upper + Lower Slaughter

items.details: Optional late-afternoon add-on: market town with boutiques and antique shops; Slaughters Manor House Hotel is in Upper Slaughter
items.name: Stow-on-the-Wold (optional)

items.details: Arrive before 8am for Arlington Row before crowds; the ivy-covered Swan Hotel faces the stream
items.name: Bibury + Arlington Row

items.details: Mid-morning into afternoon: walk the hilltop main street, cafes and shops
items.name: Burford

items.details: Option A (full day): ~1.5hr drive each way; The Manor House hotel and its Italian gardens worth the walk
items.name: Castle Combe (Option A)

items.details: Option B: morning Blockley (residential, stream) + afternoon Moreton-in-Marsh (market town, places to eat)
items.name: Blockley + Moreton-in-Marsh (Option B)

items.details: National Trust property, magical in spring; Snowshill Lavender fields nearby in summer
items.name: Snowshill Manor and Gardens

items.details: Classic village pub lunch right in Snowshill village
items.name: Snowshill Arms

items.details: Afternoon: wide high street with shops, Broadway Tower folly with multi-county views; optional quiet stop in Stanton, pub The Mount Inn

items.details: Destination farm shop and cafe; have lunch there and browse the shop

items.details: Catch-up day: revisit missed villages - Stow-on-the-Wold, Blockley, Winchcombe (antique shops), or a slow afternoon in Chipping Campden

items.details: Last morning: high street walk, coffee shop, bakery, final cream tea (Bantam Tea Rooms in Chipping Campden or Lucy's Tea Room in Stow-on-the-Wold), then depart

items.details: Dream stays she names: The Lygon Arms (Broadway), The Pig in the Cotswolds (Cirencester), The Swan Hotel (Bibury), The Manor House (Castle Combe)
items.name: Dream stays shortlist

items.details: Favorite pub of the trip with log fire; Pit Kitchen for casual outdoor lunch
items.name: The Bull / Pit Kitchen

items.details: Kid-friendly: bottle-feed lambs at Cotswold Farm Park; steam train from Toddington to Broadway on the Gloucestershire Warwickshire Steam Railway
items.name: Family activities

itineraries.summary: Selena Taylor's full 7-day Cotswolds itinerary for first-time visitors, based on Chipping Campden as home base. Covers village-by-village day plans (Bourton-on-the-Water, the Slaughters, Bibury, Burford, Castle Combe, Snowshill, Broadway), named hotels and Airbnbs, pubs and tea rooms, gardens, and family activities, with practical tips on airports, rental car and timing.
itineraries.title: Cotswolds, England: 7-Day Itinerary for First-Time Visitors

itineraries.destination: New Hampshire & Vermont (New England fall road trip)

items.details: Fly into Boston Logan (BOS); ~2.5-3hr drive to Bretton Woods NH; rental car essential. En route farm stand stops: Lull Farm, Sunnycrest Farm, Lavoies Farm, Gould Hill Farm
items.name: Drive up + farm stops

items.details: Optional before check-in: Flume Gorge (~30 min away; full 2-mile loop is 1.5-2 hrs, $18 entry) or Blair Covered Bridge classic photo stop
items.name: Flume Gorge / Blair Covered Bridge (optional)

items.details: NH base for 4 nights: Omni Mount Washington in Bretton Woods - National Historic Landmark at the base of Mount Washington, views of the Presidential Range; dinner on property
items.name: Omni Mount Washington

items.details: 1.4-mile round-trip hike from Echo Lake parking lot to hilltop overlooking lake and Franconia Notch; alt: Silver Cascade Waterfall roadside stop
items.name: Artist's Bluff

items.details: Afternoon in quaint town: Riverwalk Covered Bridge, antiquing, White Mountains Canning Company (homemade ice cream/milkshakes)
items.name: Littleton town afternoon

items.details: 34-mile loop through White Mountain National Forest. Stops: Albany Covered Bridge, Rocky Gorge (Swift River, Falls Pond, Lower Falls), Lincoln Woods Trailhead, Sabbaday Falls
items.name: Kancamagus Highway

items.details: Midday lunch stop in North Conway: award-winning fine dining or casual menu; market and deli with sandwiches, pastries, pies
items.name: White Mountain Cider Co.

items.details: Arrive ~7:30am to beat crowds; legendary breakfast spot since 1938 - buckwheat/whole wheat/oat-buttermilk pancakes with real maple syrup
items.name: Polly's Pancake Parlor

items.details: Free for Omni guests: 12-min gondola ride to Rosebrook Lodge with views; alt: Mount Washington Cog Railway (~3hr round trip) or Conway Scenic Railroad (1hr); book trains weeks ahead in peak season
items.name: Skyway Gondola / Cog Railway

items.details: Check out, drive ~2hrs southwest via Pomfret down Cloudland Road (Sleepy Hollow Farm photo stop) to Woodstock
items.name: Drive to Vermont via Cloudland Road

items.details: VT base: The Woodstock Inn & Resort in center of town (top recommendation; book 3-4 months ahead for October). Afternoon: walkable Woodstock village, Farmhouse Pottery flagship store
items.name: Woodstock Inn & Resort

items.details: Farm-to-table dinner in Woodstock village - local favorite, seasonal ingredients
items.name: Oakes & Evelyn

items.details: Family-run maple syrup and cheese producer; tour the sugarhouse, sample maple products and cheese
items.name: Sugarbush Farm

items.details: Local coffee spot in a converted camper van - lattes and brunch; nearby On The Edge Farmstand
items.name: Abracadabra Coffee Co.

items.details: Afternoon: antique shops, cozy cafes, and a maple creemee (soft serve with Vermont maple syrup) downtown
items.name: Downtown Woodstock afternoon

items.details: Glass and pottery studio in a restored 19th-century mill on the Ottauquechee River; glass-blowing demos, restaurant overlooking a waterfall
items.name: Simon Pearce

items.details: Apple picking at the century-old orchard; farm stand with fresh-pressed cider, apple pie, cider donuts; then depart
items.name: Green Mountain Orchard

itineraries.summary: Selena Taylor's 7-day New England fall foliage road trip: 4 nights in New Hampshire's White Mountains (Omni Mount Washington base, Kancamagus Highway, Artist's Bluff, Polly's Pancake Parlor) then west to Woodstock, Vermont (Cloudland Road, Sugarbush Farm, Simon Pearce, apple picking at Green Mountain Orchard). Includes her booking tips (book the Omni and Woodstock Inn 3-4 months out) and peak-foliage timing guidance.
itineraries.title: New England Fall Road Trip: 7 Days in Vermont & New Hampshire

extractions.notes: Two high-confidence day-by-day itineraries extracted from finduslost.com (Selena Taylor's travel-guide niche). Site also has many more guides (Milos, Astypalea, Kimolos) but per the 1-3 cap I kept the two explicit day-by-day plans.

items.details: Start at the last Gothic cathedral built in Spain; Flemish tapestries, marble statues
items.name: Segovia Cathedral

items.details: Artsy vegan-friendly cafe next to the Cathedral; she recommends guacamole with chips and the grapefruit and avocado salad. Alternative for cochinillo: Meson de Candido
items.name: La Almuzara

items.details: World Heritage Site, supposed inspiration for Disney's Cinderella Castle; Hall of Kings frieze; viewpoint walk to Mirador de la Pradera de San Marcos
items.name: Alcazar of Segovia

items.details: Consecrated 1208, built by the Knights Templar; secluded Romanesque church
items.name: Church of Vera Cruz

items.details: Museo Casa de la Moneda - history of money and the Spanish Royal Mint's machinery; nearby Jardines Del Rey for a short walk
items.name: Casa de la Moneda Museum

items.details: Dinner on the hotel terrace with sunset views over the city; full meal or a glass of local red wine. She provides a 2km walking map for the day
items.name: Parador de Segovia

items.details: Day 2: hire a car or taxi. Philip V's Versailles-modelled palace in the hills; remarkable interiors, 26 fountains incl. the Baths of Diana; gardens free to walk
items.name: La Granja de San Ildefonso

items.details: Hidden-gem restaurant: sustainably produced vegetables farmed on site, organic wine; overnight rooms upstairs
items.name: La Huerta De San Lorenzo

items.details: 2000-year-old Roman aqueduct, mortar-free stones, in use until mid-19th century; Loba Capitolina sculpture in front
items.name: Aqueduct of Segovia

items.details: One of Castile's richest former Jewish quarters; Corpus Christi Convent (former Main Synagogue)
items.name: Jewish Quarter (La Juderia)

items.details: Traditional Sephardic dishes with local Castilian influence in the Jewish Quarter; alternative: touristy creperie on Plaza del Azoguejo with aqueduct views
items.name: El Fogon Sefardi

items.details: Fly to Madrid then 30-minute train to Segovia; she recommends a full weekend over a day trip
items.name: Madrid train

itineraries.summary: Sabrina Iovino's (Girl vs Globe) 48-hour Segovia itinerary, split into two days: Day 1 in the old city (cathedral, vegan lunch at La Almuzara, Alcazar, Church of Vera Cruz, Casa de la Moneda museum, dinner at Parador de Segovia) and Day 2 at La Granja de San Ildefonso palace, lunch at La Huerta De San Lorenzo, the Roman aqueduct and the Jewish Quarter. Written for solo travelers with veggie-friendly restaurant picks.
itineraries.title: Things To Do in Segovia in 48 Hours

items.details: Menorca's capital; Sant Jaume Festival July 24-26 (live music, fireworks, horses); try Xoriguer gin and pomada; her favorite drink spot was Bar Lemon
items.name: Mahon

items.details: Explore by boat; she liked the glass-bottomed boats from Yellow Catamarans; boat to Isla del Lazareto (19th-century quarantine island) with sunset views over the harbour
items.name: Mahon Harbour + Isla del Lazareto

items.details: Natural beach on the north coast, ~10-min walk from free car park; no shops - bring water and snacks
items.name: Playa de Cavalleria

items.details: Small quiet beach with aquamarine water and a beach bar above; nearby Cala Biniparratx for limestone gorge and sheltered cove
items.name: Binidali

items.details: Her favorite town on the island; romantic side streets and port; try an ensaimada pastry; boutique hotels
items.name: Ciutadella

items.details: 1972 architect-designed 'fishermen's village' - white facades, cobbled streets, authentic look
items.name: Binibeca

items.details: Menorca's tallest hill (342m) with island-wide views; Sanctuary of the Verge del Toro and Christ statue on top
items.name: El Toro

items.details: Purpose-built resort but peaceful Cala Alcaufar beach with one bar/restaurant; rock formations; good for sunset
items.name: S'Algar / Cala Alcaufar

items.details: Free guided winery tour, vineyards, wine on the porch; unpretentious local cuisine (sobrasada, fish marinated in Xoriguer gin)
items.name: Binifadet Winery

items.details: Cave bar perched above the sea - her pick for a sundowner
items.name: Cova d'en Xoroi

itineraries.summary: Sabrina Iovino's list of her 11 favorite things to do in Menorca after her trip: Mahon and its harbour, beaches (Cavalleria, Binidali), Ciutadella, Binibeca, El Toro, Binifadet winery and the Cova d'en Xoroi cave bar. A recommendation list tied to her trip rather than a day-by-day plan.
itineraries.title: 11 Things To Do In Menorca

extractions.notes: Two itineraries from girlvsglobe.com (Sabrina Iovino's blog): one high-confidence day-by-day 48-hour plan (Segovia) and one medium-confidence recommendation list (Menorca). The site has more guides (Mallorca, Budapest, Iceland Golden Circle) beyond the 1-3 cap.

No extractable itinerary content. Lauren Bullen's feed and press are photo-first: interviews (Preview.ph, The Asia Collective, FAE) discuss photo editing, packing bikinis and favorite destinations (Samoa, Cappadocia, Greece, Bali) but never day-by-day plans or named hotels/restaurants/activities tied to a trip. Her personal blog GypseaLust (gypsealust.com, est. 2016) appears expired/inactive (domain expired 2022). The most trip-specific quote found (FAE, June 2022: a day at Spiaggia Grande, Positano + an Amalfi coast boat trip) is too fragmentary to constitute an itinerary. Per honesty rules, none was forced.
